blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY—The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) expanded its relief storage capacity in Eastern Visayas, providing community kitchen equipment to three Eastern Samar towns to strengthen disaster response and food assistance for affected families. The DSWD carried out the initiatives on Monday and inaugurated a1,200-square-meter extension of the agency’s Regional Resource Operations Center (RROC) warehouse in Barangay 71, Naga-Naga. It also led the turnover of World Food Programme (WFP) Community Kitchen Kits to the municipal governments of Balangiga, Giporlos, and Lawaan.
